description: This file implements the core of the ChaCha20 and XChaCha20 encryption algorithms, including cipher initialization, key and nonce handling, quarter round operations, and stream encryption functions.

classes.name: Cipher
classes.description: A stateful stream cipher instance for ChaCha20 or XChaCha20, maintaining key, nonce, counter, buffer, and precomputed values.

methods.name: NewUnauthenticatedCipher
methods.description: Creates a new ChaCha20 stream cipher with specified key and nonce, supporting standard and XChaCha20 variants.

methods.name: hChaCha20
methods.description: Generates a derived key from a 32-byte key and 16-byte nonce using the ChaCha20 core, used in XChaCha20 construction.

methods.name: quarterRound
methods.description: Core operation of ChaCha20 that shuffles bits of four state words, executed multiple times per encryption round.

methods.name: SetCounter
methods.description: Sets the cipher's block counter, ensuring no rollback occurs.

methods.name: XORKeyStream
methods.description: Encrypts/decrypts data by XORing with the generated key stream, maintaining cipher state.
